name: ParyonUSD loan (chipnet-fast-periods-6)
description: Borrow ParyonUSD (PUSD) against BCH. The loan key, a token that stays in your wallet, manages the loan: whoever holds it can add or take out collateral, repay and close, and change the interest rate. Interest is taken from the collateral; the debt in PUSD does not grow. A loan whose collateral falls below 110% of the debt at the price in Paryon's price contract can be liquidated by anyone. Paryon's deployment "chipnet-fast-periods-6".

borrower.name: Borrower
borrower.description: Holds the loan key, and opens, manages and closes the loan.

createKey.name: Make a loan key
createKey.description: Make the key of a new loan. It waits in Paryon's contract until the loan is opened with it, and comes to your wallet then.

movePeriod.name: Bring Paryon up to date
movePeriod.description: Move one of Paryon's borrowing contracts on to the current period, so that a loan opened from it is charged no interest for periods before today. Anyone may do this; it costs only the network fee.

borrow.name: Borrow PUSD
borrow.description: Open the loan: your BCH goes into the loan as collateral, Paryon takes its borrowing fee, and the borrowed PUSD and the loan key come to your wallet.

manage.name: Change the collateral
manage.description: Add BCH to the loan, or take some out while it stays above 110% of the debt. The loan key goes back to the address it came from.

repay.name: Repay part of the loan
repay.description: Pay back part of the debt in PUSD; at least 100.00 PUSD, and at least 100.00 PUSD stays owed. The PUSD paid back is destroyed. The loan key goes back to the address it came from.

close.name: Repay and close the loan
close.description: Pay back the whole debt in PUSD and close the loan. The PUSD paid back and the loan's record are destroyed; the collateral comes back to your wallet, and the loan key stays with you.

changeInterest.name: Change the interest rate
changeInterest.description: Choose the rate the loan pays from its next interest payment on. Interest is paid in BCH out of the collateral each period; the debt in PUSD does not grow. A lower rate costs less, but a redemption may be moved onto a loan with a lower rate: someone hands in PUSD for the same value in BCH out of that loan's collateral, and its debt falls by as much. The loan key goes back to the address it came from.
